configuration.measurement: plain query execute + fetch; separate EXPLAIN after each sample
configuration.cache_policy: warm; no cache flush; metadata and warmups touch data

queries.sql:
SELECT order_id, order_date, status, total_amount
FROM kmogo.orders
WHERE customer_id = 4242
  AND order_date >= DATE '2024-07-01'
ORDER BY order_date, order_id;

SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, count(o.order_id) AS order_count,
       sum(o.total_amount) AS total_spend
FROM kmogo.customers AS c
JOIN kmogo.orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_id BETWEEN 4200 AND 4249
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY c.customer_id;

SELECT status, count(*) AS order_count, sum(total_amount) AS total_amount
FROM kmogo.orders
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status;

metadata.postgres_version: PostgreSQL 16.15, compiled by Visual C++ build 1944, 64-bit

registration: 10000 customers; 200000 orders; deterministic arithmetic generation; no RNG
